headline: RBI: Auction of four GoI dated securities worth ₹33,000 crore on 27 November 2026
reference: Press Release 2026-2027/1551; GoI Notification F.No.4(1)-B(W&M)/2026 dated November 23, 2026
summary_points: GoI has announced re-issue of four dated securities for a total notified amount of ₹33,000 crore.
GoI may retain additional subscription up to ₹2,000 crore against each security; auction uses multiple price method.
Bids go through RBI e-Kuber on 27 November 2026; results the same day, settlement on 30 November 2026.
Up to 5% of each notified amount is reserved for non-competitive bidders, including via the Retail Direct portal.
who_is_affected: Banks, Primary Dealers, institutional investors and retail investors bidding in Government securities auctions.
action_required: Submit competitive bids (10:30-11:30 a.m.) or non-competitive bids (10:30-11:00 a.m.) on e-Kuber on 27 November 2026 and fund payment by 30 November 2026.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued a press release announcing the auction of four Government of India dated securities for a notified amount of ₹33,000 crore.

Securities on offer: 6.20% GS 2029 (₹9,000 crore), 6.57% GS 2033 (₹12,000 crore), 7.63% GS 2056 (₹9,000 crore) and 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 (₹3,000 crore).

Key points:
- Auction date: 27 November 2026 (Friday), multiple price method
- Settlement: 30 November 2026 (Monday)
- GoI can retain additional subscription of up to ₹2,000 crore per security
- Non-competitive bids: 10:30-11:00 a.m.; competitive bids: 10:30-11:30 a.m. on e-Kuber
- Up to 5% of each notified amount is reserved for the non-competitive segment
- 'When Issued' trading is permitted from 25 to 27 November 2026

Treasury teams, banks and Primary Dealers should plan bids and funding accordingly.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release before acting.
